display.purpose: The name, the only h1. Instrument Serif appears nowhere else.

lede.purpose: The first intro paragraph and the footer email address.

section-head.purpose: h2 below 56rem. Italic, in ink, above its section body.

section-head-margin.purpose: h2 from 56rem. Italic, soft ink, in the 10rem margin column.

body.purpose: All reading text, held to the 37rem measure. Proportional figures.

small.purpose: Dates, graph readout, contributions table, album text, fine print. Lining tabular figures where numbers align. Line-height 1.35 in captions, inherited 1.6 elsewhere.

fonts.note: Chosen by the user in the type lab. Name only.
Chosen by the user in the type lab. Slashed zero by design, no plain alternate; accepted.

shadows.name: cover
shadows.purpose: Under album cover images only. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve: link underline, album label, graph ink-in.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Link colour and underline thickness, contact icon and theme switcher colour and ground.

motion.name: album-label
motion.value: opacity and translate 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); rises 0.4rem on hover or focus
motion.purpose: The title and artist band fades in along the bottom of a cover. Pointer devices only; on touch the label sits under the cover.

motion.name: ink-in
motion.value: 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) backwards; from opacity 0, translateY(4px); delay = week index x 16ms
motion.purpose: The commit graph inks in week by week when 35% of it enters view. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; off in print and without script.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Commit graph stacks into two half-years; entry dates drop under names.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Margin column appears; section heads hang; albums go to four columns, photos to six; bullets hang in the gutter.

breakpoints.name: print
breakpoints.purpose: Black on white at 10.5pt; controls, notes and waiting sections removed; entries and figures kept whole.

breakpoints.name: dark
breakpoints.value: prefers-color-scheme: dark, or data-theme="dark" on the root
breakpoints.purpose: Blue night palette. System setting until the reader uses the switcher; the choice is saved in localStorage under "theme". data-theme="light" overrides a dark system.

graph.scale: sqrt(min(count, cap) / cap), cap = 90th percentile of active days
graph.monthLabels: 0.75rem italic soft ink, under the week a month starts in

albumFallback.note: Ground for an album with no cover art. --tint-l and --tint-c are 90% and 0.035 in Blue ink, 24% and 0.06 in Blue night.

components.name: Name
components.description: The display line. Instrument Serif appears here and nowhere else.
components.css: .ds-name { margin: 0; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(3.25rem, 1.9rem + 6vw, 5.25rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Link
components.description: Text in the surrounding ink with a pencil underline; hover thickens the underline and inks the text.
components.html: I build AI products at ev.energy.
components.css: .ds-link-line { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hyperlegible Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink); } .ds-link { color: inherit; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--pencil); text-decoration-thickness: 0.085em; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-thickness 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.2s; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--pencil-ink); text-decoration-thickness: 0.17em; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pencil); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Contact icons
components.description: A row of five icon links (email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Substack, X). Solid glyphs in ink, each in a round 2.75rem target; the name and address ride along as visually hidden text.
components.css: .ds-reach { display: flex; gap: 0.125rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-reach a { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ink); transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-reach a:hover { color: var(--pencil-ink); background: var(--frame); } .ds-reach svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Theme switcher
components.description: The dot of the "i" in the name: a solid sun in light, a crescent moon in Blue night, anchored to the letter. Falls back to a round icon button at the top right of the page where anchor positioning or the display face is unavailable. Clicking it plays a sunset: the icon in the sky sinks and draws in until the stem of the "i" hides it, the other rises from behind the stem, and every colour token fades to the other palette.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark mode" title="Switch to dark mode"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 14.5A8 8 0 0 1 9.5 4a8 8 0 1 0 10.5 10.5Z"/></svg></button> <button class="ds-theme" type="button" aria-label="Switch to light mode" title="Switch to light mode"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2.5v2M12 19.5v2M2.5 12h2M19.5 12h2M5.3 5.3l1.4 1.4M17.3 17.3l1.4 1.4M5.3 18.7l1.4-1.4M17.3 6.7l1.4-1.4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme { appearance: none; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--ink-soft); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-theme:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--frame); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pencil); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-theme svg { width: 1.2rem; height: 1.2rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.css: .ds-section { max-width: 37rem; padding-top: 1.4rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); font-family: 'Hyperlegible Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink); } .ds-section-head { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; font-size: 1.3125rem; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-entry-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; column-gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-entry-name { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-entry-name a { color: inherit; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--pencil); text-decoration-thickness: 0.085em; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-thickness 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.2s; } .ds-entry-name a:hover { color: var(--pencil-ink); text-decoration-thickness: 0.17em; } .ds-entry-name a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pencil); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-when { margin: 0; flex: none; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-role { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-entry-text { margin: 0.45rem 0 0; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-entry-list { margin: 0.55rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.15em; } .ds-entry-list li { padding-left: 0.2em; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-entry-list li + li { margin-top: 0.4rem; } .ds-entry-list li::marker { color: var(--pencil); }

components.name: Commit graph
components.description: Signature component. One dot per day on a 14-unit pitch, sized by the count; rest days small and pale; today in the pencil. Shown here as five weeks.
components.css: .ds-graph { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hyperlegible Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink); } .ds-graph-dots { display: block; width: 10rem; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-graph-dots circle { fill: var(--ink); } .ds-graph-dots .ds-rest { fill: var(--rest); } .ds-graph-dots .ds-now, .ds-graph-dots circle:hover { fill: var(--pencil); } .ds-graph-readout { margin: 0.6rem 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums; } .ds-graph-caption { margin-top: 0.9rem; max-width: 37rem; } .ds-graph-caption strong { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Album tile
components.description: A square cover with the only shadow in the system, a bold title and a soft-ink artist. The inline swatch stands in for cover art.
components.html: Album title Artist
components.css: .ds-album { display: block; width: 9rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Hyperlegible Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-album-cover { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--cover-shadow), 0 10px 22px -14px var(--cover-shadow-deep); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-album:hover .ds-album-cover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-album:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pencil); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-album-title, .ds-album-artist { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-album-title { margin-top: 0.55rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-album-artist { color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Photo tile

components.css: .ds-photo { margin: 0; width: 6rem; font-family: 'Hyperlegible Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-photo-frame { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--frame); } .ds-photo-caption { display: block; margin-top: 0.35rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: Waiting gallery
components.description: The empty state for albums and photos: an italic note, then one row of blank tiles in the frame colour. Hidden in print.
components.html: The records are still being chosen. Covers to come.
components.css: .ds-waiting { max-width: 37rem; font-family: 'Hyperlegible Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-waiting-note { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-waiting-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem 0.75rem; } .ds-waiting-row span { display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--frame); }

narrative.overview:
This is a resume set like a well-made page: one column of reading on plain paper, a serif for the name, a sans for everything else, blue ink and a single red mark. The name is a description of the craft, not a metaphor to illustrate. Nothing on the page pretends to be a letter, a notebook or a terminal. Character comes from the type, the colour and the spacing, chosen by Harry himself in a local type lab, and from three pieces of real evidence: a year of commits, his records and his photos.

The page is quiet and dense with fact. Sections are separated by a hairline and a hanging head, never by a box. Light and dark are two named palettes, Blue ink and Blue night. The reader's system setting chooses between them until the reader uses the switcher, and that choice is remembered. The page works in full with JavaScript off; the three scripts (switch the palette, copy the email, read the commit graph) are additions.

It refuses the developer-portfolio arrangement of hero, project cards and skill badges.
keyCharacteristics: One text column (37rem) with section heads hanging in a 10rem left margin on wide screens.
Instrument Serif for the name only; Hyperlegible Sans for all other text.
Upright for the record, italic for section heads and asides.
One hue of blue for paper and ink, and one mark per palette: red in light, coral in dark.
Flat paper. Hairlines divide; nothing is boxed or carded.
Plain HTML first; motion and scripting are optional extras.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Each palette has exactly one accent, the pencil, at hue 20 against the blue of everything else. It draws lines, dots, markers and rings. It never fills a block, never backs a button and never sets running text. Text only takes the pencil's ink shade as a response: on hover, or to confirm a copy.

rules.name: The Covers Bring the Colour Rule
rules.body: The page is one hue of blue (260) plus one red mark. Every other colour belongs to content: album covers and photographs are the only things on the page that are neither.

rules.name: The Reader's Setting Rule
rules.body: The palette follows `prefers-color-scheme` until the reader uses the switcher; after that their saved choice wins, in either direction. Every colour token has a value in both palettes; a new token is not finished until it has both.

rules.name: The Serif Is the Name Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears once, on the name. No other heading, number or pull-out borrows it.

rules.name: The Italic Is the Aside Rule
rules.body: Upright type carries the record: names, roles, dates, descriptions. Italic carries everything said in passing: section heads, placeholder notes, photo captions, month labels, and the graph readout.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 700 exist. Bold marks entry names, album titles and the one total in the commit caption. Emphasis inside a paragraph is not bolded.

rules.name: The One Left Edge Rule
rules.body: Wide screens have two left edges and no more: the page edge (name, hairlines, margin heads, wide figures) and the text edge (everything read). New content aligns to one of them.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Only an album cover image casts a shadow. Placeholder tiles, photos, text and controls do not.

dos: Do set new reading text in Hyperlegible Sans at 1rem and 1.6, inside the 37rem measure.
Do open every section with the 1px hairline and a hanging italic head; let space and the hairline do the dividing.
Do use the pencil for marks only: underlines, markers, the focus ring, a highlighted dot.
Do give every new colour token a Blue ink value and a Blue night value, and check text against the measured floor (soft ink is 4.58:1 in light, which leaves no headroom above 4.5, and 6.0:1 in dark).
Do use italic soft ink for anything said in passing, and upright ink for the record.
Do use lining tabular figures wherever numbers or dates line up.
Do make every enhancement optional: content in the HTML in reading order, scripted states added on top, motion inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do give an empty gallery the waiting state (a note and one row of frame-coloured tiles) and hide it in print.
Do keep print working: a new component needs a decision about how it prints.
donts: Don't use Instrument Serif anywhere but the name.
Don't add cards, boxes, panels, borders or background fills around content.
Don't add icons beyond the ones the page has: the five contact glyphs, the colophon's pilcrow and the switcher's moon and sun.
Don't add a third hue to the interface (blue at 260 for paper and ink, the pencil at 20 for marks), or use the pencil as a fill or for running text.
Don't add shadows to anything but an album cover image.
Don't add a weight other than 400 and 700, or bold a phrase inside a paragraph.
Don't build the developer-portfolio arrangement: a hero, project cards, skill badges.
Don't dress the page in a governing metaphor.
Don't force a palette. The system setting decides until the reader uses the switcher, and Blue night's values are kept identical in both places the stylesheet declares them.
Don't put content behind script, hover or an animation that must finish before it can be read.
